name: Faroe Islands
oneLineFragment: Kalsoy lighthouse under mist and sea swell.
narrativeStory:
Wind strong enough to make tears freeze on the eyelids. The promontory at Kallur feels like the ragged hem of the inhabited world.

Seabirds wheel through the gale, nesting in vertical clefts where the surf beats itself into white meringue five hundred meters below.
subtitle: Kallur Promontory • Kalsoy Island
introLines: Gale force gusts sweeping across sod-roofed villages.
Precipitous basalt sea cliffs lost in low cloud.
Seven frames exposed in freezing oceanic salt drizzle.
